description: This file provides integration code for Humanloop within a larger language model framework. It defines classes and functions to manage prompts, cache prompt data, retrieve prompts from the Humanloop API, and generate chat completion prompts using Humanloop's services. It also includes a custom logger class tailored for Humanloop integration.

classes.name: PromptManagementClient
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of prompt management data retrieved from Humanloop.

classes.name: HumanLoopPromptManager
classes.description: A cache-backed class responsible for managing prompts fetched from Humanloop API or cache, and for compiling prompts with variables.

classes.name: HumanloopLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class extending `CustomLogger`, specialized to generate chat prompts integrated with Humanloop prompts and variables.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _compile_prompt_helper( self, prompt_template: List[AllMessageValues], prompt_variables: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Substitutes variables into the prompt templates' content strings, replacing placeholders with provided values.

methods.name: PromptManagementClient _get_prompt_from_id_api( self, humanloop_prompt_id: str, humanloop_api_key: str )
methods.description: Fetches prompt data from Humanloop API using prompt ID and API key, processes response to extract prompt template and associated info.

methods.name: PromptManagementClient _get_prompt_from_id( self, humanloop_prompt_id: str, humanloop_api_key: str )
methods.description: Retrieves prompt data from cache or API, caching it if fetched from API.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] compile_prompt( self, prompt_template: List[AllMessageValues], prompt_variables: Optional[dict], )
methods.description: Compiles prompt templates into final prompts by substituting variables.

methods.name: str _get_model_from_prompt( self, prompt_management_client: PromptManagementClient, model: str )
methods.description: Determines the appropriate model to use based on prompt-specific model setting or default.

methods.name: Tuple[str,List[AllMessageValues],dict,] get_chat_completion_prompt( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], non_default_params: dict, prompt_id: Optional[str], prompt_variables: Optional[dict], dynamic_callback_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams, prompt_spec: Optional[PromptSpec] = None, prompt_label: Optional[str] = None, prompt_version: Optional[int] = None, ignore_prompt_manager_model: Optional[bool] = False, ignore_prompt_manager_optional_params: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Generates the prompt, messages, and parameters for completing a chat using Humanloop prompts, handling API key retrieval and prompt management.
